decks.title: Lore Deck — The Brothers' War (Urza, Lord High Artificer)
decks.story:
**Arc:** [The Brothers' War](../Conflicts%20%26%20Arcs.md#the-brothers-war) told from Urza's side. Urza and Mishra found the power stones in the Caves of Koilos, and their rivalry became a war that "devastated Dominaria" ([Dominaria profile](https://magic.wizards.com/en/story/dominaria-plane)). Kroog fell in **28 AR**; in **63 AR** Urza activated the sylex as Mishra's machine-self attacked; in **64 AR** "there was silence in Terisiare" ([BRO Ep. 5](https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/magic-story/the-brothers-war-episode-5-as-cruel-as-necessary)). The blast shattered Terisiare into an archipelago ([Planeswalker's Guide to Dominaria](https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/planeswalkers-guide-dominaria-2022-08-31)).

**How the deck tells it (guidance):** you open in Tocasia's dig and on the Koilos stones, build Urza's workshops and lands, and field the war machines of Kroog and the Argivian armies. Lat-Nam's Third-Path wizards stand by as interaction. If the game goes long, Golgothian Sylex is the war's ending. Karn and the Metathran look ahead to Urza's later legacy.

cards.name: Karn, Scion of Urza
cards.note: Karn is the silver golem Urza created ([Karn profile](https://magic.wizards.com/en/story/karn-planeswalker)).

cards.name: Karn, Living Legacy
cards.note: Karn — Urza's creation and a Legacy artifact ([Dominaria profile](https://magic.wizards.com/en/story/dominaria-plane)).

cards.name: The Mightstone and Weakstone
cards.note: The two power stones Urza and Mishra found in the Caves of Koilos ([Dominaria profile](https://magic.wizards.com/en/story/dominaria-plane)).

cards.name: Tocasia's Dig Site
cards.note: Tocasia's dig, where the brothers' story begins (card flavor).

cards.name: Tawnos's Coffin
cards.note: Named for Tawnos, Urza's apprentice; printed in Antiquities (ATQ). Repeatable creature exile adds interaction.

cards.name: Transmute Artifact
cards.note: Printed in Antiquities (ATQ). Artifact tutor replacing Fabricate.

cards.name: Strip Mine
cards.note: Printed in Antiquities (ATQ); its flavor text names the war between Urza and Mishra. Single-target land removal (not mass land denial).

cards.name: Mishra's Factory
cards.note: Named for Mishra; printed in Antiquities (ATQ). Manland adds a threat on an artifact-dense mana base.

cards.name: Golgothian Sylex
cards.note: The sylex is the weapon Urza activates in 63 AR, ending the war ([BRO Ep. 5](https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/magic-story/the-brothers-war-episode-5-as-cruel-as-necessary)).

decks.win_path: combat with Constructs, thopters and Urza himself; Golgothian Sylex is the story finale (sacrifice for a board wipe), not a guaranteed one.

decks.title: Lore Deck — Nahiri, the Lithomancer
decks.story:
**Character:** [Nahiri](../Planeswalker%20Dossiers.md#nahiri), the kor lithomancer of Zendikar. Six thousand years ago, with Ugin and Sorin, she trapped the Eldrazi on Zendikar; "At Ugin's direction, Nahiri constructed a massive network of stone structures called hedrons" ([BFZ Story Summary](https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/magic-story/battle-zendikar-story-summary-2015-12-23)). When the Eldrazi nearly escaped, "neither Sorin nor Ugin returned to help" (same source). She was later trapped in the Helvault for a millennium and took revenge on Sorin, which unleashed Emrakul on Innistrad ([Stone and Blood](https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/magic-story/stone-and-blood-2016-06-15)). She hunted the Lithoform Core in the Skyclaves ([ZNR Ep. 1](https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/magic-story/episode-1-heart-skyclave-2020-09-02)), was compleated on New Phyrexia, and survived, vowing "No Planeswalker will set foot on Zendikar ever again" ([Beyond Repair](https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/magic-story/beyond-repair)).

**How the deck tells it (guidance):** Kor of Zendikar carry the lithomancer's forged weapons (Nahiri's own abilities make Kor Soldiers and move Equipment). Hedrons and Ugin's tools build the prison. The Helvault package is her imprisonment and her revenge on Sorin's plane, and the Skyclave cards are the ZNR hunt. 🚫 The compleated Nahiri (ONE) is red-white, so it cannot appear in a mono-white deck; that chapter is told only in the summary.
